hardware: evaluation servers: Linux 5.10 x86_64, 64 CPU cores, 600 GB RAM, 8 GPUs per server
PD production evaluation: 5 nodes x 8 GPUs; 4 prefill nodes and 1 decode node
NCCL IBRC over InfiniBand for prefill-to-decode KV transfer
NVLink-class high-speed intra-node interconnect assumed for tensor parallel communication
software: IBM fastsafetensors integration plus RTP fastsafetensors
model: Qwen 7B and Qwen 4B production traffic services
additional 8B-32B models including Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Moonlight-16B-A3B for loading
datasets: real Alibaba internal Robot Q&A traffic
WikiText-2 sampled subset for quantization perplexity
baselines: traffic scheduling disabled within RTP-LLM for production scheduling ablation
multiple TP/DP deployment configurations under equal GPU budget

settings.name: production comparison workload
settings.description: For PD disaggregation and speculative sampling framework comparisons, paper states input 200K tokens and output 16K tokens throughout.

settings.name: PD large-MoE deployment
settings.description: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct-FP8 with FP8 KV cache; 5 nodes, each 8 GPUs; prefill 4 nodes/decode 1 node; TP=8, EP=8, DP=1 per node; prefill batch 64, decode concurrency 128.

settings.name: speculative controlled test
settings.description: DeepSeek-V3-0324, TP=8/DP=1, max_batch_size=32, max_new_tokens=500, FP8 KV cache, speculative step size 1.

settings.name: real MTP test
settings.description: Qwen3-235B-A22B, 1,000 production queries, average input 19.5K and output 800 tokens, concurrency 64-512; compares 4TPx4, 1TP8DP, 2TP4DP, 2TP8DP.

settings.name: quantization test
settings.description: Qwen3-32B single GPU, max_batch_size=64, top-p=1, top-k=1, temperature=0; max_new_tokens 500/800/1000/1200; Baseline, AWQ(FP8), FP8 KV cache.

settings.name: multimodal test
settings.description: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct on GQA, TP=2 across two GPUs, max_batch_size=64, max_new_tokens=500, top-p=1, top-k=1, temperature=0.

data.correctness: Speculative sampling follows proposal-score-verify-update semantics intended to preserve target-model output distribution. Quantization fidelity is measured by WikiText-2 perplexity: reported configurations span PPL 7.59-8.09 versus baseline 7.59-7.67, with RTP-LLM within 0.01 PPL of baseline in the compared AWQ/FP8-KV settings described by the paper. Multimodal framework comparison uses identical decoding parameters.
data.methodology: Evaluation intentionally mixes production A/B-style workloads and controlled framework benchmarks. Traffic scheduling is measured against the same service with scheduling disabled; PD and speculative decoding use real online models/workloads as well as framework baselines; model loading, quantization, and EPD use controlled comparisons against vLLM/SGLang.
data.scope: Strongest evidence is production deployment and end-to-end engineering effectiveness, but different subsections use different models/workloads/configurations. The paper does not establish that every RTP-LLM component individually causes the full headline speedups, and does not report broad statistical confidence intervals across repeated deployments.
